title: 2003 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 2
statement: \(O P E N\) is a square, and \(T\) is a point on side \(N O\), such that triangle \(T O P\) has area 62 and triangle \(T E N\) has area 10 . What is the length of a side of the square?

solutions.text:
12
\(62=P O \cdot O T / 2\) and \(10=E N \cdot T N / 2=P O \cdot T N / 2\), so adding gives \(72=P O \cdot(O T+\) \(T N) / 2=P O \cdot O N / 2=P O^{2} / 2 \Rightarrow P O=12\).
